agents.not-present: {agent} is not detected on this computer.
agents.foreign: {agent} already has a Sidevoice registration that Sidevoice did not create; it was left unchanged.
agents.invalid: {agent} has an unreadable or malformed Sidevoice registration; it was left unchanged.
agents.registration-unknown: Sidevoice could not determine whether {agent} already has a Sidevoice registration.
agents.busy: Another host agent request is still running. Try again shortly.
agents.registration-not-confirmed: The Sidevoice registration for {agent} could not be confirmed after the command succeeded.
service.unsupported: The private Rust service proof supports macOS launchd only on this build.
hook.voice-waiting: Sidevoice: {count} new voice messages are waiting for this conversation.
hook.check-unavailable: Sidevoice could not check for waiting voice messages ({detail}); the tool call continues.
service.proof-profile-required: The Rust service commands are available only with an explicit private proof profile (`--profile-root P`).
service.manager-unavailable: The Sidevoice service manager could not be queried ({detail}).
service.no-installation: Sidevoice is not installed on this computer: run `sidevoice install` first.
service.unsafe-value: A value for the service definition ({what}) contains a control character; nothing was written.
service.definition-unsafe: The private Sidevoice service definition is unsafe ({detail}); nothing was changed.
service.not-loaded: The Sidevoice service is installed but its service manager did not start it ({detail}). Start it with `sidevoice service start`, or reinstall it with `sidevoice install --no-agents --service`.
service.executable-missing: The Sidevoice service points at a program that is not there any more ({detail}). Reinstall: `sidevoice install --no-agents --service`.
service.unload-failed: The service manager did not unload the Sidevoice service ({detail}); nothing was deleted.
service.node-stopped: Sidevoice was stopped by the person at this computer; run `sidevoice service start` to resume.
service.killed: Processes that did not stop in time were killed: {pids}.
ready.timeout: The core did not become ready in time.
identity.unreadable: The core could not read this machine's identity.
bind.port-in-use: The core's port is taken by another program.
import.missing-module: The core is missing a part it needs ({detail}).
launch.missing-executable: The core's program is not where it was installed ({detail}).
launch.permission: The core's program cannot be run: permission denied ({detail}).
bind.core-running: Another Sidevoice core is already running for this data directory.
